item.title: Center for Materials, Devices and Integrated Systems (CMDIS) Facilities Open House 2026
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 9, 2026 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM - Center for Materials, Devices and Integrated Systems (CMDIS) invites you to the Facilities Open House on Wednesday, September 9th. Sign-up for facility tours to learn about new acquisitions, tools, instrumentation capabilities, fabrication and characterization techniques. Get information about educational programs and short courses. Meet with our technical team and discuss how we can help your research. The event will be followed by BBQ…

item.title: Dean Liad Wagman to Lead Free International Webinar on Responsible AI in Research
item.description: On Thursday, September 11, 10 to 11 a.m. ET, Liad Wagman, Dean of the RPI Lally School of Management, will lead a free webinar hosted by AACSB International, the global accrediting body for business schools, on how schools are moving from AI policy to daily practice. The session covers research integrity, teaching and assessment, and administration and governance, with practical approaches relevant beyond business schools. Register today!

item.title: TIAA Confidential Counseling (In-Person)
item.description: Date: Tuesday, September 8, 2026 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM - A TIAA Financial Consultant will be available for one-on-one consultations on a broad range of retirement topics. Attend this upcoming event to help you become better informed and more confident about Rensselaer’s retirement plan benefits. Consultations will be conducted in 60 minute increments. To schedule your individual retirement counseling, please call TIAA at 1-800-732-8353 or online at https://www.tiaa.org/public/login/schedule-meeting

item.title: Leadercamp: The 12 Lifetraps Hindering Your Impact
item.description:
Date: Tuesday, September 8, 2026 9:00 AM - 10:00 AM - Discover the hidden patterns that can limit confidence, relationships, decision-making, and leadership effectiveness. In this Leadercamp, participants will explore the lifetraps that quietly shape behavior and learn how to recognize when old patterns are getting in the way of present-day impact. The session will offer practical tools for increasing self-awareness, breaking unhelpful cycles, and leading with greater clarity and intention.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
